fields.System.Title: OUT-503 — Suggest a carton size
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want the system to suggest which box to use, so that I stop guessing
and we stop shipping air.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the order contents and product dimensions, then the smallest suitable carton
  • from the configured list is suggested.
  • - Given contents that will not fit any single carton, then a multi-carton split is
  • suggested.
  • - Given a product with missing or implausible dimensions, then no suggestion is made and
  • the product is flagged for a data quality report.
  • - Given the suggestion, then the packer may choose a different carton without a reason —
  • it is advisory only.
  • - Given hazmat or temperature-controlled products, then packing restrictions are applied
  • before size optimisation.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | carton, product |
| Risks | Wrong product dimensions in master data ([doc 03 §3](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
